description:
Full skin detail: price, order book, history, cross-market prices. Everything the skin's wiki page shows, as data. `skin` is the full catalogue record (creator, workshop
title and dates, collection, flags, store price and availability, crafting components, glow/cutout ratios,
colours). `price` is the canonical wiki price in cents and `price_source` says which side of the book it came
from. `orderbook` is Steam's live book: lowest sell order, highest buy order, order counts, the `buy_orders`
and `sell_orders` depth ladders (`{price, quantity}`, best first) and `fetched_at`; the headline price
refreshes more often than the ladders, so they can briefly trail it. `steam_history` is the last year of
Steam's own sale history (`recorded_at`, median sale `price`, `volume`; `sale_basis` false means Steam has no
sale series and the points are our ask-price readings instead) - wider ranges via /skins/{itemdefid}/history.
`market_stats` is the page's Community & Market Stats card: an archived SCMM snapshot (frozen September 2026)
of `supply_total`/`supply_total_estimated`/`supply_total_owners_estimated`, Workshop `subscriptions_current`/
`subscriptions_lifetime`, `favourited_current`, `views`, `votes_up`/`votes_down`, `market_24hr_value`,
`market_168hr_value`, `market_last_30d_sales`, `market_rank_index`, `market_liquidity_score`, the market
high/low with their dates, `change_7d_percent`/`change_30d_percent`/`change_90d_percent` and `ath_percent`;
